Sorry, I'm a little confused now. There's no way around what?

> It is important to keep a mapping, but I believe this might be better as a
chapter at the end to better allow folks to consume it electronically

Agreed... that definitely sounds useful.

My comments previously weren't about if/how we maintain a mapping (I really like the idea of machine-readable mappings), but rather how we agree on what the new grouping for each control would be - purely looking at this from the perspective of inviting community involvement.
